Kija_Trader.label: Role labels (trader, protector, ranger, defender, veteran, warrior, cleanser, villager) are written in the masculine: a PawnKindDef label has no gender switch. A labelFemale form could be added: your call.

Kija_Chest.label: 'fourrure de torse' chosen for 'chest fur'; alternative 'fourrure pectorale'.
